What is Dekton

THE SURFACE FOR DESIGN AND ARCHITECTURE

Dekton is a carbon neutral ultracompact porcelain surface with an optimised manufacturing process inspired by the beauty and aesthetics of natural stone that goes beyond nature, achieving the highest product performance.

With a great variety of colours and sizes, Dekton inspires the future of architecture and design by creating soulful spaces where beauty and functionality coexist in perfect synergy.

Dekton is ultracompact

Dekton represents excellence in functional beauty for any architectural project.

Dekton’s exclusive press generates 25 000 tons of uniform pressure (2.5 times the weight of Eiffel Tower). As a result of this ultracompaction process, Dekton has no micro-defects that cause tensions or weak points, and it has a null porosity.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2" css=".vc_custom_1659956164744{padding: 52px !important;background-color: #9ecfd8 !important;}"][vc_column_text css=""]

Dekton is innovation

Dekton’s manufacturing process with the TSP technology makes the material a high performance, allowing it to outperform when compared to standard porcelain.

Dekton represents excellence in functional beauty for any architectural project. Dekton’s versatility makes it ideal for any application, even in the most demanding conditions such as facades or floors. Why Dekton

  • Advantages

    The beauty of peak performance
    [vc_section el_class="cos-slider cos-slider-6a82d7e03f88a cos-slider-cards" content_placement="middle" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" ]
    [vc_row content_placement="middle" row_active_carousel="true" row_num_columns_desktop="3" row_num_columns_tablet="2" row_num_columns_mobile="1" row_space_between_tablet="0.25" row_space_between_mobile="0.5" cos_custom_arrows="true" cos_white_bullets="false" cos_white_arrows="" cos_slides_to_scroll="1"][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Abrasion resistant

    Dekton withstands abrasion, outperforming standard porcelain. It is ideal for all interior and exterior applications including facades and flooring in commercial spaces subject to high activity.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Scratch & impact resistant

    Dekton’s great resistance to impact and scratches makes it perfect for everyday use.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Water & stain resistant

    Dekton boasts very low porosity, making it extremely resistant to water and stains, which can be easily removed with standard cleaning products.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Extreme temperature and fire resistant  

    It's low coefficient of thermal expansion makes it ideal for projects exposed to sudden changes in temperature. The A1 certification accredits Dekton as a non-combustible material. 
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    UV-ray resistant

    Dekton is unaffected by ultraviolet rays. Its colour does not fade or degrade overtime, maintaining the same appearance as the first day it was installed in any interior or exterior application.
    [/vc_column][/vc_row]
    [/vc_section]

  • Design Options

    The beauty of imagining with no limits
    [vc_section el_class="cos-slider cos-slider-6a82d7e03f88a cos-slider-cards" content_placement="middle" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" ]
    [vc_row content_placement="middle" row_active_carousel="true" row_num_columns_desktop="3" row_num_columns_tablet="2" row_num_columns_mobile="1" row_space_between_tablet="0.25" row_space_between_mobile="0.5" cos_custom_arrows="true" cos_white_bullets="false" cos_white_arrows="" cos_slides_to_scroll="1"][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Variety of sizes

    Dekton is available in small in 710 x 710 mm formats and large 3200 x 1440 mm slabs, perfect for creating visual continuity in large spaces with the minimum number of joints.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Variety of thicknesses

    Available in 30, 20, 12, 8 or 4 mm (Dekton Slim). A thickness for each application, always ensuring the highest performance. 
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Variety of colours and textures

    Each Dekton collection offers a myriad of colours in a variety of finishes from ultra-glossy, to matte or velvet options.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Easy installation & cost optimization

    Lower cost and greater lightness with Dekton Optimma format (260 x 100 cm in 4 mm thickness) specially designed and paneled for the most common vertical cladding applications.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Creation of continuous spaces

    Thanks to its properties, Dekton can be installed with practically imperceptible joints and guarantee tonal uniformity over the entire surface covering large spaces with a continual and natural way.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Customization possibilities

    Dekton offers the possibility of customizing colours and complex cuts, creating unique pieces that create unforgettable spaces opening up limitless design possibilities.
    [/vc_column][/vc_row]
    [/vc_section]

  • Innovations

    Essence of Nature. Soul of Technology
    [vc_section el_class="cos-slider cos-slider-6a82d7e03f88a cos-slider-cards" content_placement="middle" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" cos_section_fluid_container="" cos_section_margin_top="" cos_section_margin_bottom="" cos_section_padding_top="" cos_section_padding_bottom="" cos_background_type="" cos_background_cut_in_tablet="" cos_background_cut_in_responsive="" cos_cut_height="" cos_cut_color_superior="" cos_cut_color_inferior="" cos_background_image="" ]
    [vc_row content_placement="middle" row_active_carousel="true" row_num_columns_desktop="3" row_num_columns_tablet="2" row_num_columns_mobile="1" row_space_between_tablet="0.25" row_space_between_mobile="0.5" cos_custom_arrows="true" cos_white_bullets="false" cos_white_arrows="" cos_slides_to_scroll="1"][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Dekton Slim

    4mm thickness in large format that offers unlimited design options and incredible ease of installation and transportation.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Optimma Format

    The Dekton slab has been optimized for the most common cladding applications to create a new format with improved cost, design, installation and handling.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    X-Gloss

    A luminous and dazzling finish achieved by mechanical polishing, without the need for enamels or other materials.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Grip+

    A soft touch with a non-slip finish and maximum grip, recommended for indoor and outdoor areas such as swimming pools, shopping center entrances, airports, stairs, terraces, and more.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Protek

    A protective mesh designed by Cosentino especially for the most demanding applications. It has A2 s1 d0 certification, the highest fire resistance after A1.
    [/vc_column][vc_column width="1/3"]

    Quick Cut

    Technology developed by Cosentino that allows Dekton to be cut three times faster without altering its properties.
    [/vc_column][/vc_row]
